title: Cloud VPN and Cloud Interconnect: the road in from the datacentre

videos.script: The office has to reach the planner's network. There are two roads. {{roads}} Cloud VPN runs encrypted tunnels over the internet. It is cheap, and it works the same afternoon. {{vpn}} HA VPN has two interfaces, and you build a tunnel from each. That is what earns four nines. {{ha}} The routes are not written by hand. A Cloud Router speaks BGP with the office's router, and each side learns the other's ranges. {{bgp}} The shared secret never goes in the file. Terraform asks for it, hides it on screen, and still keeps it in its state, so the state is guarded too. {{secret}} Cloud Interconnect is the other road: a circuit, not the internet. Dedicated, if you are in Google's building. Partner, through a provider, if you are not. {{interconnect}} Then the arithmetic. You will compare four designs, in minutes down a month and in dollars. {{sla}} The second VPN tunnel costs thirty-six dollars a month and buys back about thirty-nine minutes. Nobody argues about that one. {{end}}
